title: MODISONLTD — Trade Brief · 03 Jun 2026
catalyst: Record Q4 FY26 (net profit +278% YoY to ₹36 Cr; EBITDA margin doubling to ~24.8% from 11.8%) has pushed Modison to its 52-week high — the decisive swing variable now is whether that margin step-up is structural or mean-reverts toward the historical 9–12%.
